topics.name: One global ocean
topics.detail: Aik connected global ocean zameen ki taqreeban 71% satah cover karta hai; yeh area ka percent hai. Volume ke hisab se Earth ke taqreeban 97% pani oceans mein aur baqi taqreeban 3% oceans se bahar glaciers, groundwater, rivers/lakes waghera mein hai. Taleemi tor par paanch named ocean basins hain.
topics.note: Yaad rakhein: 71% zameen ki satah ka hissa hai, jabke 97% tamam pani ka hissa hai; dono mukhtalif measures hain.

topics.name: Pacific Ocean
topics.detail: Pacific sab se bara aur sab se gehra ocean basin hai. Mariana Trench, Ring of Fire aur Columbia River ka mouth isi basin se related MCQs mein aate hain.

topics.name: Atlantic Ocean
topics.detail: Atlantic Europe aur Africa ko Americas se alag karta hai. Amazon isi ocean mein girta hai; Bermuda Triangle western North Atlantic mein bataya jata hai.

topics.name: Indian Ocean
topics.detail: Indian Ocean Africa, Asia aur Australia ke darmiyan hai. Bay of Bengal is ka north-eastern hissa hai aur Dar es Salaam is ocean par aik port hai.

topics.name: Arctic Ocean
topics.detail: Arctic paanch named ocean basins mein sab se chhota hai. Bering Strait isay Pacific se milata hai; Canada ke north mein bhi isi ocean ka sahil hai.

topics.name: Southern Ocean
topics.detail: Southern ya Antarctic Ocean Antarctica ko gherta hai. Is ke 60 degree South wale northern limit par tamam mulkon ka ittefaq nahin, is liye boundary convention ke sath parhein.

topics.name: Mariana Trench & Challenger Deep
topics.detail: Mariana Trench western Pacific mein hai. Challenger Deep isi trench ka hissa aur ocean ka sab se gehra known point hai; ocean basin aur trench ka farq yaad rakhein.

topics.name: Pacific Ring of Fire
topics.detail: Pacific ke gird plates ki boundaries par earthquakes aur volcanoes ka belt Ring of Fire kehlata hai; poora Pacific pani khud 'ring' nahin hai.

topics.name: Zealandia beneath the ocean
topics.detail: Zealandia ka taqreeban 94% hissa ocean ke neeche hai. Yeh geographical continent ka concept hai, Pacific ya Southern Ocean ka naya naam nahin.

topics.name: Arabian Sea
topics.detail: Pakistan ka southern maritime boundary Arabian Sea hai. Makran Coast, Karachi Harbour aur Indus ka delta isi se relate karte hain.

topics.name: Mediterranean Sea
topics.detail: Mediterranean Europe ke south aur North Africa ke north mein hai. Nile ka delta, Alexandria aur Tripoli is ke coast se related hain; Suez Canal ise Red Sea se milata hai.

topics.name: Red Sea
topics.detail: Red Sea Africa aur Asia ke darmiyan hai. North par Gulf of Suez aur Gulf of Aqaba ki do branches hain; Suez Canal isay Mediterranean se jorta hai.

topics.name: Black Sea
topics.detail: Black Sea Europe aur western Asia ke darmiyan hai. Bosporus se Sea of Marmara tak raasta milta hai; Danube is mein girta hai aur Georgia is ke coast par hai.

topics.name: Caspian Sea
topics.detail: Naam 'Sea' hai lekin Caspian landlocked saltwater lake hai, ocean se direct connection nahin. Surface area se duniya ki sab se bari lake; is ke kinare paanch countries hain.

topics.name: Aral Sea
topics.detail: Aral Sea Kazakhstan aur Uzbekistan ke darmiyan aik inland lake hai. Amu Darya aur Syr Darya isay historically pani dete thay; diversion ki wajah se is ka area bohat ghata.

topics.name: Dead Sea
topics.detail: Dead Sea Jordan ke ilaqe mein aik landlocked salt lake hai, actual oceanic sea nahin. Jordan River is mein girta hai; WEF MENA ka location bhi paper mein poocha gaya.

topics.name: Sulu Sea
topics.detail: Sulu Sea Pacific ka marginal sea hai aur Palawan, Borneo aur Sulu Archipelago ke darmiyan waqay hai.

topics.name: Andaman Sea
topics.detail: Andaman Sea Indian Ocean ka eastern hissa hai. Thailand ka Phuket is region mein hai aur Strait of Malacca is basin ko South China Sea route se jorta hai.

topics.name: South China Sea
topics.detail: South China Sea western Pacific mein hai. Spratly Islands aur Philippines-China arbitration ke questions is se linked hain; disputed claims ko factual sea location se alag samjhein.

topics.name: East China Sea
topics.detail: Yangtze River China ke east coast par East China Sea mein discharge karta hai.

topics.name: Bohai Sea
topics.detail: Yellow River ka delta Bohai Sea mein khulta hai; Yellow Sea aur Bohai Sea ko aik naam na samjhein.

topics.name: North Sea
topics.detail: Rotterdam ka port, tidal Thames aur Rhine ke mouths North Sea se related hain. Baltic tak Danish Straits ka route hai.

topics.name: Baltic Sea
topics.detail: Baltic Sea northern Europe mein hai aur Danish Straits ke zariye North Sea se connected hai.

topics.name: Caribbean Sea
topics.detail: Caribbean Sea Atlantic ke western tropical side par hai; Venezuela ka northern coastline is par hai.

topics.name: Sargasso Sea
topics.detail: Sargasso Sea poori tarah Atlantic mein hai. Is ki land shoreline nahin; ocean currents is ka boundary area define karte hain.

topics.name: Sea of Azov
topics.detail: Sea of Azov Black Sea ke north mein chhota basin hai; Mariupol is ke coast par hai.

topics.name: Adriatic Sea
topics.detail: Adriatic Mediterranean ka northern arm hai; Venice Lagoon ka Lido di Venezia is sea ki taraf barrier hai.

topics.name: Tyrrhenian Sea
topics.detail: Italy ke west side par Tyrrhenian Sea Mediterranean ka hissa hai; Tiber River isi mein girti hai.

topics.name: Sea of Marmara
topics.detail: Bosporus Black Sea ko Sea of Marmara se milata hai. Marmara phir Dardanelles ke zariye Aegean route se connected hai.

topics.name: Suez Canal
topics.detail: Egypt ki artificial sea-level canal Mediterranean aur Red Sea ko milati hai. Construction 1859 mein shuru hui aur opening 1869 mein hui.

topics.name: Panama Canal
topics.detail: Panama Canal Atlantic aur Pacific ko connect karti hai. Ships locks se Gatun Lake ki bulandi tak uthte hain; is liye route sirf khuli sea-level channel nahin.

topics.name: English Channel
topics.detail: English Channel southern England aur northern France ke darmiyan hai. Channel-swimming questions mein Dover wali English coast aam reference hai.

topics.name: Strait of Hormuz
topics.detail: Hormuz Persian Gulf ko Gulf of Oman se milata hai. Iran is ke northern side par hai; is ko khud gulf na samjhein.

topics.name: Bosphorus / Bosporus
topics.detail: Istanbul se guzarta Bosporus Black Sea aur Sea of Marmara ko connect karta hai; shehar ke European aur Asian sides is ke opposite kinare hain.

topics.name: Strait of Malacca
topics.detail: Malacca Strait Peninsular Malaysia aur Indonesian Sumatra ke darmiyan maritime passage hai; Andaman Sea se South China Sea ki taraf shipping route deta hai.

topics.name: Bering Strait
topics.detail: Bering Strait Asia aur North America ko alag karta aur Pacific ko Arctic Ocean se milata hai.

topics.name: Danish Straits / Oresund
topics.detail: Danish Straits Baltic aur North Sea ke darmiyan passage hain. Oresund Denmark aur Sweden ke darmiyan, Copenhagen ke qareeb hai.

topics.name: Golden Gate Strait
topics.detail: San Francisco Bay ka Pacific ki taraf entrance Golden Gate Strait hai, jis par Golden Gate Bridge bana hai.

topics.name: Gulf of Mexico
topics.detail: Paper ke Gulf of Mexico question mein isay duniya ka sab se bara gulf aur United States, Mexico, Cuba se bordered body of water poocha gaya hai.
topics.note: U.S. federal agencies isay Gulf of America kehti hain; existing MCQ mein Gulf of Mexico naam use hua hai.

topics.name: Bay of Bengal
topics.detail: Bay of Bengal Indian Ocean ka north-eastern bay hai; Ganges-Brahmaputra Delta is mein khulta hai.

topics.name: Persian Gulf
topics.detail: Persian Gulf ka ocean se raasta Strait of Hormuz aur phir Gulf of Oman se guzarta hai. Qatar aik peninsula hai jo is gulf mein project karti hai.

topics.name: Gulf of Oman
topics.detail: Gulf of Oman Arabian Sea aur Strait of Hormuz ke beech waterway hai; Hormuz ke doosri taraf Persian Gulf hai.

topics.name: Gulf of Aqaba
topics.detail: Red Sea ki north-eastern branch Gulf of Aqaba hai; ise Gulf of Suez wali north-western branch se confuse na karein.

topics.name: Gulf of Suez
topics.detail: Gulf of Suez Red Sea ki north-western branch hai, jahan Suez Canal ka southern end hai.

topics.name: Gulf of Aden
topics.detail: Gulf of Aden Arabian Peninsula aur Horn of Africa ke darmiyan hai; Yemen north aur Somalia southern side par hain.

topics.name: Ise Bay
topics.detail: Japan ka Port of Nagoya Ise Bay par situated hai.

topics.name: Pakistan & Makran Coast
topics.detail: Pakistan ka Arabian Sea wala coast Sindh aur Balochistan mein hai. Balochistan ka provincial coastline sab se lamba hai; Gwadar, Pasni, Ormara is side ke ports hain.

topics.name: Astola Island
topics.detail: Astola Pakistan ke Balochistan coast ke qareeb Arabian Sea mein hai; 2017 mein Pakistan ka pehla marine protected area declare hua.

topics.name: Manora Island & Karachi Harbour
topics.detail: Manora Island Karachi Harbour ke samne Arabian Sea ki taraf hai. Isay Astola ke sath confuse na karein: Manora Karachi, Astola Balochistan coast par hai.

topics.name: Great Barrier Reef
topics.detail: Great Barrier Reef duniya ka sab se bara coral reef ecosystem hai; Australia ke Queensland coast ke paas hai aur 1981 mein UNESCO World Heritage List par aaya.

topics.name: Greenland
topics.detail: Greenland continents ko exclude karne par duniya ka sab se bara island hai. Yeh North Atlantic aur Arctic Oceans ke darmiyan hai.

topics.name: Indonesia: Archipelago
topics.detail: Indonesia Indian aur Pacific Oceans ke darmiyan duniya ka bohat bara archipelagic state hai; sawal mein 'largest archipelagic state' ke jawab mein Indonesia aata hai.

topics.name: Spratly Islands
topics.detail: Spratly Islands South China Sea mein hain. Multiple states ke claims ko yaad karte waqt claim aur internationally settled sovereignty ko aik baat na samjhein.

topics.name: Phuket
topics.detail: Phuket Thailand ka island province hai, Andaman Sea region mein. Mediterranean ke islands se is ka geographic context mukhtalif hai.

topics.name: Diego Garcia
topics.detail: Diego Garcia Indian Ocean ka island hai, British Indian Ocean Territory ka hissa aur military facility ke liye paper mein poocha gaya.

topics.name: Cape Agulhas
topics.detail: Cape Agulhas South Africa mein 20 degree East longitude par Atlantic aur Indian Oceans ki official hydrographic boundary ka reference hai; Cape of Good Hope se alag jagah hai.

topics.name: Cape of Good Hope
topics.detail: Cape of Good Hope South Africa ki Cape Peninsula par hai. Vasco da Gama ke Europe-to-India sea route se related paper mein aata hai; ocean boundary ke liye Cape Agulhas poocha jata hai.

topics.name: Canada Coastline
topics.detail: Canada ka coastline duniya mein sab se lamba maana jata hai. Canada ko Pacific, Atlantic aur Arctic teen ocean basins touch karte hain.

topics.name: Whitehaven Beach
topics.detail: Whitehaven Beach Australia ke Queensland mein Whitsunday Island par hai; bright white sand mein silica bohat zyada hai.

topics.name: Trunk Bay
topics.detail: Trunk Bay U.S. Virgin Islands ke St. John island par hai.

topics.name: Bathsheba Beach
topics.detail: Bathsheba Beach Barbados ke east coast par hai, Atlantic side ki beach.

topics.name: Horseshoe Bay & Magnetic Island
topics.detail: Horseshoe Bay Australia ke Queensland state mein Magnetic Island par hai; Townsville coast ke qareeb island aur bay ka naam alag yaad rakhein.

topics.name: Nazare Beach
topics.detail: Nazare Portugal ki Atlantic coast par aik beach aur fishing-town area hai.

topics.name: Tsunami
topics.detail: Tsunami ki aam geological wajah samandar ke neeche bara earthquake aur seabed ki sudden vertical movement hoti hai. Landslide aur volcanic eruption bhi isay generate kar sakte hain.

topics.name: Kuroshio / Japan Current
topics.detail: Kuroshio, Japan Current bhi kehlata hai. Yeh western North Pacific ki warm current hai jo Taiwan ke east coast se Japan ki taraf north-east mein behti hai.

topics.name: Estuary & Brackish Water
topics.detail: Estuary aam tor par river aur sea ke milne ki jagah hai. Freshwater aur seawater mix hon to brackish water banta hai; har estuary zaroori nahin ke brackish ho.

topics.name: Coastal Lagoon
topics.detail: Lagoon coast par pani ka basin hai jo sandbar, barrier island ya reef se open sea se partly separated hota hai. Kuch lagoons mein salt aur fresh water ka mix brackish hota hai.

topics.name: Continental Shelf & Law of the Sea
topics.detail: Continental shelf samundari tal par continent ka submerged extension hai. Pakistan ke extended continental shelf aur UNCLOS Article 76 se related MCQs existing bank mein hain.

topics.name: Ocean Heat & Climate
topics.detail: Pani ki high heat capacity ki wajah se ocean ki surface nearby land ke muqablay mein dheere seasonal temperature change dikhati hai. Ocean greenhouse warming ki extra heat ka bara hissa absorb karta hai.

topics.name: Sea Level Rise
topics.detail: Global warming se average sea level barhne ke do key mechanisms garam seawater ki thermal expansion aur land ice ka melt hona hain.

topics.name: Marine Sedimentary Rocks
topics.detail: Ocean mein jamne wali sediments waqt ke sath sedimentary rocks bana sakti hain; marine shells ki accumulation se limestone bhi ban sakta hai.

topics.name: Seabird Salt Glands
topics.detail: Marine birds excess namak nikalne ke liye aankhon ke upar supraorbital salt glands use kar sakte hain; yeh adaptation namkeen pani ke environment mein madad deti hai.

topics.name: Bermuda Triangle
topics.detail: Bermuda Triangle ko western North Atlantic ka aik loosely described region kehte hain; is ke official mapped borders nahin. Paper ka geography jawab Atlantic Ocean hai.
